correctness.rationale: For T positive task magnitudes and mean-one rates, sum actual G_i=T Gbar but sum targets=T Gbar M_alpha; summing signed residuals gives normalized L1 lower bound |1-M_alpha|. Explicit positive normalized G allocations x_i=s_i+1-M for M<1 and x_i=s_i/M for M>1 attain it and map to positive weights w_i=T(x_i/a_i)/sum(x_j/a_j). Strict Jensen forces heterogeneous M below/at/above one as alpha<1/=1/>1; ratio-preserving correction unique. Independent rational example T=3, rates(1/2,1,3/2),alpha=2 produced M=7/6 and attained floor 1/6 with weights (45,120,162)/109. Only instantaneous target compatibility claimed, not training failure.
residual_risks: Sharpness relies on strictly positive unweighted gradients; zeros and constraints on task weights are outside scope.
